title: Redaction of sensitive text in isolation by DLP engine: settings, behaviour and what it does not cover

checks.do: Whether the file or image that still shows sensitive data is covered by redaction at all.
Whether Allow Copy & Paste From is enabled on the Security tab before clipboard redaction is configured.

what-is-redacted.statement: Redaction in an isolation profile (Internet & SaaS or Private Access) lets the admin choose which sensitive information from which Internet & SaaS DLP engines is redacted for users during isolation.

quotes: Enabling redactive sensitive text in your Internet & SaaS isolation profiles or Private Access isolation profiles allows you to manage which sensitive information from which Internet & SaaS DLP engines is redacted for users during isolation.

replacement-symbols.statement: During an isolated session, sensitive data on a web page is replaced in real time with password-blocking symbols, and printing is also subject to redaction.

quotes: the sensitive data on a web page is replaced with password-blocking symbols (e.g., ●●●●●) in real time.
Printing is also subject to redaction.

files-not-redacted.statement: Enabling redaction does not impact files: images, PDFs and uploaded or downloaded file types still show sensitive data.

quotes: Enabling redaction does not impact files, meaning that images, PDFs, or uploaded or downloaded file types still show sensitive data.

zia-redaction-settings.statement: The Internet & SaaS profile Data Redaction tab takes DLP engines, the dictionaries to redact for each engine, web page redaction, optional redaction of editable fields rendered in web pages, clipboard data redaction, a redaction message, and an option to display the last four characters.

quotes: DLP Engine: Select the DLP engines containing sensitive text that you want redacted during an isolation session.
Dictionaries to Redact: For each DLP engine, select the DLP dictionaries that you want redacted.
Redact Editable Fields: (Optional) If you enable redaction of web pages, enable redaction of editable fields rendered within isolated web pages.
Redaction Message: Enter a redaction message to display to users during an isolation session.
Display last 4 characters: Enable this setting to display the last four characters of the sensitive text (i.e., partial redaction).
Web Pages: Enable or disable redaction of web pages.
Clipboard Data: Enable or disable redaction of clipboard data.

clipboard-needs-copy-paste.statement: Clipboard data redaction can be configured only if the Allow Copy & Paste From settings are enabled on the Security tab (stated in both profile articles).

quotes: Clipboard Data: Enable or disable redaction of clipboard data. You can configure this setting only if you enable Allow Copy & Paste From settings on the Security tab.
Clipboard Data: Enable or disable redaction of clipboard data. You can configure this setting only if you enable Allow Copy & Paste From settings on the Security tab.

pa-redaction-labels.statement: The Private Access profile labels the engine setting DLP Engines to Match and the editable-field setting Redact Data Entry Fields.

quotes: DLP Engines to Match: Select the DLP engines containing sensitive text that you want redacted during an isolation session.
Redact Data Entry Fields: (Optional) If you enable redaction of web pages, enable redaction of editable fields rendered within isolated web pages.
